set_seed: set a reproducible random seed for numpy and python random using a base seed and index list
chunks: split a list into smaller chunks of a specified size using a generator
is_power_of_2: check if a given integer is a power of two using bitwise operations
align_to_page: align a memory pointer address to the nearest page boundary given a page size
decode_null_terminated_string: decode a numpy byte array containing a null-terminated ASCII string into a Python string
